constraints.ocl:
context CheckIn
inv: self.isOnline implies self.boardingPass <> null

context BoardingPass
inv: ((self.seat <> null) and (self.seat.oclIsTypeOf(Seat))) and (self.checkIn.booking.createdAt <> '')

context BoardingPass
inv: (self.seat <> null) and (self.gate <> null)

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 4 and self.weightKg <= 56

context Aircraft
inv: (self.seats->any(x | x.seatNo <> '') <> null) and (self.airline.oclIsTypeOf(Airline))

context Booking
inv: (self.baggages->collect(x | x.weightKg)->notEmpty()) and (self.bookingRef <> '' and self.bookingRef.size() > 0)

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null implies self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null and self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null and self.arrivalTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null

context Airline
inv: (self.aircrafts->one(x | x.registrationNo <> '')) and (self.flights->size() >= 2 and self.flights->size() <= 3)

context Baggage
inv: (self.weightKg >= 11 and self.weightKg <= 72) and (self.weightKg < 11)

context Aircraft
inv: (((self.seats->isEmpty()) and (self.airline.oclIsTypeOf(Airline))) and (self.registrationNo.indexOf('test') >= 0)) and (not(((self.seats->isEmpty()) and (self.airline.oclIsTypeOf(Airline))) and (self.registrationNo.indexOf('test') >= 0)))

context Airport
inv: (self.departingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.departingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Airport
inv: (self.arrivingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.arrivingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Aircraft
inv: ((self.registrationNo <> '') and (self.seats->forAll(v | v.seatNo <> ''))) and (self.seats->exists(v | not(v.seatNo <> '')))

context Airline
inv: (self.flights->exists(x | x.departureTime <> '')) and (not(self.flights->exists(x | x.departureTime <> '')))

context CheckIn
inv: (self.boardingPass <> null) and (not(self.boardingPass <> null))
